# Ahmed Qotp

> Software engineer and web designer based in Alexandria, Egypt. Founder of Ao Company.

## About
Ahmed Qotp (also written Ahmed Abdo, Ahmed Qotb; Arabic: أحمد قطب) is a software engineer and web designer based in Alexandria, Egypt. He is the founder of Ao Company, which provides web design and digital product development.

## Work
- Websites and landing pages
- Web applications (React, Next.js)
- Dashboards and management / ERP systems
- UI/UX design
- Technical consulting

## Note
Not to be confused with other people who have similar names, such as Ahmed Kotp (a science instructor) or Ahmed AlQotb (a voice artist).
